title: Seetha's wish to go to forest along with Rama
introduction: In this chapter Seetha asks Rama to take her to the forest.
closing: || इति श्रिमद् रामयने अयोध्य कान्दे षत्विंसः सर्गः ||
Thus complets the twenty sevent chapter of Ayodhya Kaanda in Srimad Ramayana.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ता तु वैदेही प्रिय अर्हा प्रिय वादिनी |
प्रणयात् एव सम्क्रुद्धा भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
evam uktā tu vaidehī priya arhā priya vādinī |
praṇayāt eva samkruddhā bhartāram idam abravīt
verses.translation: Sita, who speaks kindly and deserves kind utterances, after hearing Rama's words, became angry out of love alone and spoke thus to her husband.

verses.devanagari:
किमिदम् भाषसे राम वाक्यम् लघुतया ध्रुवम् |
त्वया यदपहास्यम् मे श्रुत्वा नरवरात्मज
verses.iast:
kimidam bhāśhase rāma vākyam laghutayā dhruvam |
tvayā yadapahāsyam me śrutvā naravarātmaja
verses.translation: Oh, Rama the prince! What words these are you speaking? These light words certainly are to be laughed at by you and to me after hearning.

glosses.meaning: the prince! kim vaakyam = what words
you are speaking? yat = which words

verses.devanagari:
आर्य पुत्र पिता माता भ्राता पुत्रः तथा स्नुषा |
स्वानि पुण्यानि भुन्जानाः स्वम् स्वम् भाग्यम् उपासते
verses.iast:
ārya putra pitā mātā bhrātā putraḥ tathā snuṣā |
svāni puṇyāni bhunjānāḥ svam svam bhāgyam upāsate
verses.translation: "Oh, noble prince! Father, mother, brother, son and daughter-in-law accomplish their own good fortune, as benefitted by their own pious deeds."

verses.devanagari:
भर्तुर् भाग्यम् तु भार्या एका प्राप्नोति पुरुष ऋषभ |
अतः चैव अहम् आदिष्टा वने वस्तव्यम् इति अपि
verses.iast:
bhartur bhāgyam tu bhāryā ekā prāpnoti puruṣa ṛṣabha |
ataḥ caiva aham ādiṣṭā vane vastavyam iti api
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama the best of men! Wife for one gets fortune of the husband. For that reason, I am also destined to dwell in the forest."

verses.devanagari:
न पिता न आत्मजो न आत्मा न माता न सखी जनः |
इह प्रेत्य च नारीणाम् पतिर् एको गतिः सदा
verses.iast:
na pitā na ātmajo na ātmā na mātā na sakhī janaḥ |
iha pretya ca nārīṇām patir eko gatiḥ sadā
verses.translation: " To a woman, father or son or self or mother or female companion are not the recourse. Husband alone is forever the best recourse either in this world or after her death".

verses.devanagari:
यदि त्वम् प्रस्थितः दुर्गम् वनम् अद्य एव राघव |
अग्रतः ते गमिष्यामि मृद्नन्ती कुश कण्टकान्
verses.iast:
yadi tvam prasthitaḥ durgam vanam adya eva rāghava |
agrataḥ te gamiṣyāmi mṛdnantī kuśa kaṇṭakān
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! If you set forth now itself to the forest, which is difficult to be travelled, I shall come before you, by trampling down thorns and grass with long pointed stalks."

glosses.meaning: which is difficult to be travelled
grass with long pointed stalks and thorns.

verses.devanagari:
ईर्ष्या रोषौ बहिष् कृत्य भुक्त शेषम् इव उदकम् |
नय माम् वीर विश्रब्धः पापम् मयि न विद्यते
verses.iast:
īrṣyā roṣau bahiṣ kṛtya bhukta śeṣam iva udakam |
naya mām vīra viśrabdhaḥ pāpam mayi na vidyate
verses.translation: "Oh, brave man! By abandoning, as water left over after drinking, the impatience and anger and having faith, take me. There is no sin in me."

verses.devanagari:
प्रासाद अग्रैः विमानैः वा वैहायस गतेन वा |
सर्व अवस्था गता भर्तुः पादच् चाया विशिष्यते
verses.iast:
prāsāda agraiḥ vimānaiḥ vā vaihāyasa gatena vā |
sarva avasthā gatā bhartuḥ pādac cāyā viśiṣyate
verses.translation: "Protection under the feet of the husband is better than being on top of a lofty building or in aerial cars or in moving through the sky or in attaining all types of positions."

glosses.meaning: or attaining all types of positions.

verses.devanagari:
अनुशिष्टा अस्मि मात्रा च पित्रा च विविध आश्रयम् |
न अस्मि सम्प्रति वक्तव्या वर्तितव्यम् यथा मया
verses.iast:
anuśiṣṭā asmi mātrā ca pitrā ca vividha āśrayam |
na asmi samprati vaktavyā vartitavyam yathā mayā
verses.translation: "My mother and father taught me of different matters long ago. I need not be told now, how to deal in any way with anyone."

glosses.meaning: to deal in any way with any one.

verses.devanagari:
अहम् दुर्गम् गमिष्यामि वनम् पुरुषवर्जितम् |
नानामृगगणाकीर्णम् शार्दूलवृकसेवितम्
verses.iast:
aham durgam gamiśhyāmi vanam puruśhavarjitam |
nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇam śārdūlavṛkasevitam
verses.translation: " I can come to forest which is inaccessible, which is devoid of people, filled with various types of animals and inhaited by tigers and jackals."

glosses.meaning: filled with various types of animals

verses.devanagari:
सुखम् वने निवत्स्यामि यथा एव भवने पितुः |
अचिन्तयन्ती त्रीम्ल् लोकामः चिन्तयन्ती पति व्रतम्
verses.iast:
sukham vane nivatsyāmi yathā eva bhavane pituḥ |
acintayantī trīml lokāmḥ cintayantī pati vratam
verses.translation: "Not thinking of three world, thinking of loyalty to husband, I shall dwell in the forest happily as though staying in our father's house".

glosses.meaning: thinking pativratam = of loyalty to husband

verses.devanagari:
शुश्रूषमाणा ते नित्यम् नियता ब्रह्म चारिणी |
सह रंस्ये त्वया वीर वनेषु मधु गन्धिषु
verses.iast:
śuśrūṣamāṇā te nityam niyatā brahma cāriṇī |
saha raṃsye tvayā vīra vaneṣu madhu gandhiṣu
verses.translation: "Oh, brave man! performing service to you regularly, having the necessary discipline, observing chastity, I would like to stay with you in the forests which smell like honey."

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् हि कर्तुम् वने शक्तः राम सम्परिपालनम् |
अन्यस्य पै जनस्य इह किम् पुनर् मम मानद
verses.iast:
tvam hi kartum vane śaktaḥ rāma samparipālanam |
anyasya pai janasya iha kim punar mama mānada
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, the bestower of honour! Here in the forest, you are indeed capable of protecting other people also. Why to tell about my protection?"

glosses.meaning: the giver of honour! iha = here

verses.devanagari:
सह त्वया गमिश्यामि वसमद्य न संशयः |
नाहम् शक्या महाभाग निवर्तयितु मुद्यता
verses.iast:
saha tvayā gamiśyāmi vasamadya na saṃśayaḥ |
nāham śakyā mahābhāga nivartayitu mudyatā
verses.translation: "Today no doubt, I will come to forest along with you. Oh, the illustrious! I, with this intention, cannot be prevented to do so."

glosses.meaning: ready(to go to forest) na shakyaa = cannot

verses.devanagari:
फल मूल अशना नित्यम् भविष्यामि न संशयः |
न ते दुह्खम् करिष्यामि निवसन्ती सह त्वया
verses.iast:
phala mūla aśanā nityam bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ |
na te duhkham kariṣyāmi nivasantī saha tvayā
verses.translation: I shall live only on roots and fruits always, no doubt. Living along with you, I shall not create any unpleasantness to you.

glosses.meaning: the eater of fruits and roots

verses.devanagari:
इच्चामि सरितः शैलान् पल्वलानि वनानि च |
द्रष्टुम् सर्वत्र निर्भीता त्वया नाथेन धीमता
verses.iast:
iccāmi saritaḥ śailān palvalāni vanāni ca |
draṣṭum sarvatra nirbhītā tvayā nāthena dhīmatā
verses.translation: " With you the learned and the lord, I shall not have fear anywhere. I wish to see rivers, mountains, small lakes and grooves."

verses.devanagari:
हंस कारण्डव आकीर्णाः पद्मिनीः साधु पुष्पिताः |
इच्चेयम् सुखिनी द्रष्टुम् त्वया वीरेण सम्गता
verses.iast:
haṃsa kāraṇḍava ākīrṇāḥ padminīḥ sādhu puṣpitāḥ |
icceyam sukhinī draṣṭum tvayā vīreṇa samgatā
verses.translation: I shall be comfortable, by coming together with you, the courageous man. I desire to see lotus- ponds filled with swans, water-fowls and excellently flowered.

verses.devanagari:
अभिषेकम् करिष्यामि तासु नित्यम् यतव्रता |
सह त्वया विशाल अक्ष रंस्ये परम नन्दिनी
verses.iast:
abhiśhekam kariśhyāmi tāsu nityam yatavratā |
saha tvayā viśāla akṣa raṃsye parama nandinī
verses.translation: "Oh, the large eyed lord! Remaining dedicated to you, I shall take bath regularly in those lakes and with full of joy, I shall sport with you."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् वर्ष सहस्राणाम् शतम् वा अहम् त्वया सह |
व्यतिक्रमम् न वेत्स्यामि स्वर्गोऽपि हि न मे मतः
verses.iast:
evam varṣa sahasrāṇām śatam vā aham tvayā saha |
vyatikramam na vetsyāmi svargo'pi hi na me mataḥ
verses.translation: Thus spending even a hundred thousand years in your company I shall never find any deviation/ Heaven also will not be acceptable to me otherwise.

verses.devanagari:
स्वर्गे अपि च विना वासो भविता यदि राघव |
त्वया मम नर व्याघ्र न अहम् तम् अपि रोचये
verses.iast:
svarge api ca vinā vāso bhavitā yadi rāghava |
tvayā mama nara vyāghra na aham tam api rocaye
verses.translation: Oh, Lion among men and seion of Raghu! Even if in heaven there is residence for me without you, I do not like it.

glosses.meaning: do not like tamapi = that too.

verses.devanagari:
अहम् गमिष्यामि वनम् सुदुर्गमम् |
मृग आयुतम् वानर वारणैः युतम् |
वने निवत्स्यामि यथा पितुर् गृहे |
तव एव पादाव् उपगृह्य सम्मता
verses.iast:
aham gamiṣyāmi vanam sudurgamam |
mṛga āyutam vānara vāraṇaiḥ yutam |
vane nivatsyāmi yathā pitur gṛhe |
tava eva pādāv upagṛhya sammatā
verses.translation: I shall proceed to the forest, which is very much inaccessible and occupied by monkeys, elephants as well as other animals. Clining to your feet alone, I shall dwell in the forest as though in father's home.

verses.devanagari:
अनन्य भावाम् अनुरक्त चेतसम् |
त्वया वियुक्ताम् मरणाय निश्चिताम् |
नयस्व माम् साधु कुरुष्व याचनाम् |
न ते मया अतः गुरुता भविष्यति
verses.iast:
ananya bhāvām anurakta cetasam |
tvayā viyuktām maraṇāya niścitām |
nayasva mām sādhu kuruṣva yācanām |
na te mayā ataḥ gurutā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "Therefore, grant well my prayer and usher me- me without any other thought, whose mind is fondly attached to you and who am determined to die if separated from you. Due to this, there will be no burden to you from me."

verses.devanagari:
तथा ब्रुवाणाम् अपि धर्म वत्सलो |
न च स्म सीताम् नृ वरः निनीषति |
उवाच च एनाम् बहु सम्निवर्तने |
वने निवासस्य च दुह्खिताम् प्रति
verses.iast:
tathā bruvāṇām api dharma vatsalo |
na ca sma sītām nṛ varaḥ ninīṣati |
uvāca ca enām bahu samnivartane |
vane nivāsasya ca duhkhitām prati
verses.translation: sita along with him eventhought she was speaking as a foresaid. To hold her back from coming to forest, he also started talking highly of the various afflictions she might have to face in a forest.
